## What it is

Linkwarden collects bookmarks into collections and keeps its own copy of each page (screenshot, PDF and a readable text version), so links still work after the original site changes or disappears ([linkwarden/linkwarden](https://github.com/linkwarden/linkwarden)).

**Licence:** `AGPL-3.0` (GitHub licence API). Market class **L2**. There is no license-matrix row yet, so the gate notes that it is not preinstallable on sold boxes until one is added (brief 30 B10).

**Icon:** a neutral generated icon with initials; no upstream logo is shipped.

## Market listing

- Category and sub-tags (docs/design/TAXONOMY.md §1): notes: bookmarks, read-later. The sub-tags go into `metadata.tags` once the schema has it.
- Deployment class (TAXONOMY §2): **Market · community** until CI writes a passing scan (contract §9.4), then Market · verified if every check passes.

## How it runs here

- One `Deployment` (`Recreate`) with Linkwarden (web app and archiving worker in one container, as upstream runs them) and PostgreSQL 16 (the major version upstream's compose file uses) as a native sidecar on 127.0.0.1 only. PostgreSQL trusts local connections, so there is no database password and no Secret.
- `NEXTAUTH_SECRET` (signs sign-in sessions) is generated once by an init container onto the data volume and exported by the container command, which then runs upstream's own command unchanged.
- Non-root: Linkwarden as UID 1000 (upstream prepares the image for non-root use), PostgreSQL as UID 999. No privilege escalation, all capabilities dropped.
- Volumes: `linkwarden-data` (20 GiB, `/data/data`, the page copies) and `linkwarden-db` (5 GiB).
- Probes: `GET /` (the image's own HEALTHCHECK); startup allows 10 minutes for migrations.

## First run

Source: [docs.linkwarden.app](https://docs.linkwarden.app) (self-hosting with Docker).

1. Install Linkwarden from the Market and approve the action. It installs into `app-linkwarden`.
2. Forward the port and open http://localhost:3000:
   ```sh
   kubectl -n app-linkwarden port-forward svc/linkwarden 3000:3000
   ```
3. Register your account. Registration stays open until you turn it off (`NEXT_PUBLIC_DISABLE_REGISTRATION`), so register right after install.
4. Install the browser extension or add links in the web app.

## Not done yet

- Meilisearch (full-text search across saved pages) is not packaged; search uses the database.
- No AI tagging: it needs an Ollama or provider endpoint, set in Linkwarden's settings.
- No HTTPS or LAN hostname: OneMind v0 has no ingress or certificates for apps, so the web UI is reached through a port-forward until the app proxy exists. `NEXTAUTH_URL` matches that port-forward; sign-in from another address needs it changed.
- `readOnlyRootFilesystem` is not set: it has not been tested against this image.
- Resource figures are OneMind choices; upstream publishes none. They are checked against real use when the CI smoke test (contract §9.4 check 9) runs.
- `metadata.tier` stays `community` until `sdk/tools/app-gate` in CI writes a passing `scan.json`. `spec.updates.automerge` is `none` until `renovate.json` lists the app.
